images.description: Abstract blue and pink financial lines for hero section background
Abstract geometric blocks for feature visualization

icons.usage: Use stroke-width={1.5} for a clean, thin look

general: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states.
Use 'Manrope' for all numbers to ensure tabular alignment.
Default to Light Mode for the Landing Page, but allow Dark Mode toggle.
Dashboard should support both modes, but Dark Mode is preferred for charts.
accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1.
Use aria-labels for all icon-only buttons.
Support keyboard navigation for the stock selector.
testing: Add data-testid to all critical interactive elements (e.g., 'buy-button', 'stock-search-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Clean Fintech' aesthetic. Use the provided image URLs for the landing page. Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the dashboard. Ensure the 'Prediction' UI is distinct and easy to read. Use Recharts or Lightweight Charts for data visualization.
